title: BusinessCardRequest
description: A business card associated with a contact or organization

BusinessCardKey.description: A Karbon-generated unique identifier for the Business Card

EntityType.description: The type of entity this Business Card belongs to.

EntityKey.description: A Karbon-generated key to indicate the entity (Contact, Organization, or ClientGroup) this Business Card belongs to.

IsPrimaryCard.description: Set to true, if this business card is also the primary business card for this entity.

OrganizationKey.description: Used on the Business Card for a Contact to specify the Organization that the Contact is related to. Will always be null for an Organization business card.

WebSites.description: The websites associated with this Business card.

EmailAddresses.description: The email addresses associated with this Business card.

RoleOrTitle.description: The business role or title of the contact this Business Cards belongs to

FacebookLink.description: The URL to the entity's Facebook profile

LinkedInLink.description: The URL to the entity's LinkedIn profile

TwitterLink.description: The URL to the entity's Twitter profile

SkypeLink.description: The URL to the entity's Skype profile

Label.description: The tag to indicate the type of Address

Number.description: The phone number of the entity

Label.description: The tag to indicate the type of phone number
